# Sergii Grygoryshyn — Philosophical & Cultural Expeditions in Germany (2027)

> Intimate 4-day / 3-night philosophical, literary, and art-historical expeditions across Germany led by PhD philosopher Sergii Grygoryshyn. Private central conference hall for morning and evening lectures, officially registered museum visits, and independent hotel booking by participants. Available in English, German, Russian, and Ukrainian.

- Author & Scholar: Sergii Grygoryshyn, PhD (https://grygoryshyn.com/publications)
- Format: 4 days / 3 nights, small group of 4–10 guests, pre-registration without upfront payment
- Telegram Organizer: @Grygoryshyn

## Curatorial Lines (Series)
- **Writers & Philosophers** (Dichter & Denker / Писатели и философы): Cities where literature and philosophy clashed with tyranny—from 18th-century Enlightenment and Romantic longing to Hegel’s dialectic and 1848.
- **Artists & Photographers** (Maler & Fotografen / Художники и фотографы): How the European eye transformed—from Romantic light mysticism and Biedermeier studios to the first silver daguerreotypes and modern rupture.

## 2027 Expedition Cities & Direct Pages
### №01 Stuttgart (Штутгарт / Stuttgart) — Jan 28–31, 2027 (Thu–Sun)
- Track: Writers & Philosophers
- Theme: Literary Stuttgart: Enlightenment, Romanticism & Revolution of Spirit / Литературный Штутгарт: Просвещение, романтизм и революция духа
- Summary: From Joseph Süß Oppenheimer and Schubart through young Schiller’s escape, Hauff’s Romanticism, and 1848 barricades to Hegel’s dialectic and Eduard Mörike’s autumn loop
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/stuttgart/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/stuttgart/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/stuttgart/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/stuttgart/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: StadtPalais — Museum für Stuttgart (Oppenheimer Case); Hospitalkirche (C. F. D. Schubart Memorial & Grave); Altes Schloss & Akademiegarten (Schiller’s Karlsschule); Hoppenlau-Friedhof (Wilhelm Hauff’s Grave & Monument); Schillerplatz (Thorvaldsen’s 1839 Bronze Schiller Monument); Staatsgalerie & Haus der Geschichte (Dannecker & 1848); Hegel-Haus (Birthplace Museum & Monument); Silberburganlage (Eduard Mörike Monument & Fountain)

### №02 Hamburg (Гамбург / Hamburg) — Feb 25–28, 2027 (Thu–Sun)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: Runge’s Light and the Ruins of Old Hamburg / Огонь Рунге и руины старого Гамбурга
- Summary: From early Romantic light mysticism through Biedermeier calm to the Great Fire of 1842 and silver daguerreotypes
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/hamburg/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/hamburg/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/hamburg/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/hamburg/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: Conference Hall by the Binnenalster; Hamburger Kunsthalle (Runge & Gensler Galleries); Deichstraße & Nikolaifleet (1842 Fire Origin); St. Nikolai Memorial Spire & Old Town Hall Site; Museum of Hamburg History (Holstenwall); Caffamacherreihe (Artists’ Association Garden, May 6, 1843); Ohlsdorf Park Cemetery (Graves of Runge & the Genslers)

### №03 Dresden (Дрезден / Dresden) — Mar 26–29, 2027 (Fri–Mon)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: Metaphysics of Fog and the Romanticism of Ruins / Метафизика тумана и романтизм руин
- Summary: Caspar David Friedrich, Dresden Romanticism, and the phenomenology of stone
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/dresden/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/dresden/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/dresden/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/dresden/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: Conference Hall & Albertinum; Frauenkirche; Trinitatisfriedhof (Friedrich’s Grave)

### №04 Berlin (Берлин / Berlin) — Apr 23–27, 2027 (Fri–Tue · 4 Days + Day 5 AM)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: The Granite Bowl in Sacred and Profane Reality / Гранитная чаша в сакральной и профанной реальности
- Summary: From Schinkel’s sacred geometry and Hummel’s Granite Bowl through Krüger, Gaertner, and the 1840–1888 photographic desacralization to Menzel’s industrial physics and the Day 5 Closed Room.
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/berlin/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/berlin/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/berlin/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/berlin/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: The Granite Bowl in the Lustgarten; Alte Nationalgalerie; Friedrichswerder Church (Gaertner’s Viewpoint); Opernplatz — Franz Krüger’s Parade Stage; Schinkelplatz & Site of the Bauakademie; Schloßplatz & Breite Straße (Schwartz & 1848); Parochialstraße Quarter & Central Seminar Hall

### №05 Frankfurt (Франкфурт / Frankfurt am Main) — May 28–31, 2027 (Fri–Mon)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: Städel Museum & the Dialectic of Enlightenment / Штедель, бюргеры и диалектика Просвещения
- Summary: How a banking capital gave rise to Critical Theory
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/frankfurt/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/frankfurt/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/frankfurt/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/frankfurt/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: Städel Museum; Institute for Social Research & Seminar Hall; Goethe House & Römerberg

### №06 Munich (Мюнхен / München) — Jun 25–28, 2027 (Fri–Mon)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: Dürer’s Alchemy & the Blue Rider / Алхимия Дюрера и тень «Синего всадника»
- Summary: Alte Pinakothek, Altdorfer, and Kandinsky’s leap into abstraction
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/munich/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/munich/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/munich/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/munich/)
- Key Landmarks & Museums: Alte Pinakothek; Lenbachhaus (Der Blaue Reiter); Conference Hall & Schwabing

### №07 Vienna (Вена / Wien) — Jul 23–27, 2027 (Fri–Tue)
- Track: Artists & Photographers
- Theme: Hypnosis and Order: Secrets of Viennese Biedermeier / Гипноз и порядок: тайны венского бидермайера
- Summary: Portraiture as purchasing eternity, hidden revolt inside genre painting, the biopolitics of early artist deaths, and Waldmüller’s rupture from imperial hypnosis.
- URLs: [EN](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/en/vienna/) · [DE](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/de/vienna/) · [RU](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/ru/vienna/) · [UK](https://dagrosimo.github.io/retreat/uk/vienna/)
